summary: Recent updates to Firefox now ensure that **HTTP Live Streaming (HLS)** is treated as a first-class media source, which means it can be used more efficiently for streaming video content. This change is significant because it allows developers to leverage HLS for delivering high-quality live broadcasts and on-demand video directly in the browser, improving the overall streaming experience for users. By properly integrating HLS, Firefox enhances compatibility with various video services, paving the way for better media playback without needing additional plugins or players.
